newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 3 as Plate grain fixing reported.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 3 as Plate grain fixing reported.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up three points on Wednesday at 1,493 with brokers reporting a high volume of grain fixing from the Plate although the USGulf remained relatively subdued.

Significantly higher Panamax fixtures were reported in the east where Glencore were reported to have fixed Oinoussian Seaman 64,235 dwt delivery Red Sea end March for six to eight months at $12,000 daily.

MOSK fixed Maritime Mosaic 73,600 dwt delivery Muscat early April trip via Goa to Japan $14,750 daily and Transfield fixed the 1977 built Heliopolis 64,400 dwt delivery Philippines end March trip via West Australia to China at $13,250 daily.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was 20 points down to unchanged and turnover was 58 lots.
